message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts. The case: Chen (陈某) pretended to be a distributor of a company (欧某公司) after the sales cooperation agreement expired, sold a product that was not actually produced, collected money 24160 yuan, didn't deliver, later changed phone number to avoid contact. He returned the money and got victim's forgiveness.

This is likely fraud (诈骗) or maybe illegal business operation, but typical Chinese criminal law: "诈骗罪" (fraud) when obtaining property by false pretenses. Also possibly "非法经营" (illegal business) but the main is fraud. Also maybe "侵犯商业秘密"? No. It's selling non-existent goods, misrepresentation. So charge: 诈骗.

Also maybe "非法经营罪" if using a company's name without permission? But the facts: He concealed that the cooperation agreement ended, used the company's name to sell. That's false representation to obtain money. So fraud.

Thus answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>
